reason: Paper is about targeted latent adversarial training; backdoor removal is one of three application experiments alongside jailbreaks and unlearning.
Paper evaluates LLMs' grade-school math problem-solving and the reasoning gap on compositional pairs; math reasoning is the focus.
Main contribution is parameter-efficient multimodal Transformers; self-supervised pretraining is only the setting and not engaged directly.
Proposes SpikePoint, a point-based spiking neural network architecture for event-based action recognition.
Framework attaches sparse autoencoders to LLM layers to obtain independent latents for token-level influence; SAEs are core ingredient.
Method uses transformer self-attention values as rationale guidance; the transformer module is the core mechanism of SR-GCL.
Paper introduces a long-term memory benchmark and LIGHT memory framework; retrieval augmentation appears only as a baseline condition.
Agent-X benchmarks vision-language models' multi-step reasoning and tool use; VLMs are the evaluated systems.
LMMs like GPT-4o only motivate the work; paper builds speech-to-text alignment for LLMs.
Benchmark evaluating VLMs on contextual integrity in location disclosure; VLMs are the object of study.
Keyframe selection to overcome MLLM long-video context limits; method and experiments target MLLM video understanding.
Studies scaling behavior of pretrained and finetuned LLMs on machine translation; LLMs are the studied models.
Paper improves HNSW vector search via quantization; RAG is not mentioned in the abstract.
Benchmark evaluates vision-language models on cross-view reasoning and CoRL trains them with RL; VLMs are the studied models.
Focus is LLM-based GAN-like synthetic tabular data generation; context usage is a minor component, not studied as in-context learning.
Proposes SGHormerVQ bridging graph transformers and spiking neural networks via spiking vector quantization.
Paper proposes an OOD detection method for Transformers; text classification is only the evaluation setting, not the subject.
Introduces cross-lingual knowledge distillation (XD) as the main contribution.
Paper is a nonlinear multimodal brain encoding model; LLaMA only supplies extracted features as one ingredient.
Paper proposes DiSR, a new prompt optimization approach decomposing prompts into scaffolds and residuals.
Proposes triplane Gaussian splatting representation and framework for 3D object generation.
Paper proposes a kernel relative test for machine-generated text detection; LLMs are only the source of the texts.
Develops a split conformal prediction method guaranteeing coherent factuality for language model outputs.
Paper proposes Uni2Det, a multi-dataset 3D detection framework evaluated on KITTI, Waymo and nuScenes.
Benchmarks graph condensation methods, the graph analogue of dataset distillation; abstract never names dataset distillation itself, so the call is close.
Proposes enhanced Gaussian kernels and compensation to improve 3D Gaussian splatting.
Learned heuristics for large-scale vehicle routing, a combinatorial optimization problem; the paper's main contribution is solving such problems.
New video task, dataset and method that constrains cross-attention in VLMs; evaluated against SOTA VLMs, so MLLMs are the base.
Proposes a metric and benchmark for off-policy evaluation; offline RL is the broad area, not directly addressed.
Core method introduces progressive knowledge distillation between teacher and student classifiers within a meta-learning framework.
Empirical study of pre-trained models for out-of-distribution (domain) generalization with a resulting SOTA method.
Proposes a Mixture of Heterogeneous Enhancement Experts as a core component of the detector.
OneReward uses a single VLM as a generative reward model to drive multi-task RL; reward model is the core idea.
Develops Monte Carlo Forest Search for combinatorial problems such as UNSAT proofs; combinatorial search is the setting.
Proposes Projected Conditional Flow Matching for unsupervised MRI reconstruction.
Text style-transfer model with back-translation; generative models is a broad umbrella not specifically engaged.
Paper proposes separable bijective networks for integration over input space; regression is not mentioned or engaged in the abstract.
Benchmark of LLMs on ICU time series classification; agents are never the focus.
Pre-training method built on multimodal diffusion trajectories of protein structures; diffusion is central to the method.
Paper uses normalizing flows on polytopes; flow matching is not the method or subject.
Benchmarks and enhances LLM agents for Linux kernel fault localization; agents are the object of study.
Modular multi-expert framework for zero-shot multimodal reasoning; vision is one modality among several, not the focus.
Identifies bias in reward models and proposes calibration method CHARM; reward models are the direct subject.
Paper analyzes flatness and adversarial robustness across architectures; LLMs only appear as an extension of results.
Proposes Cooperative Training, a new method for training generative models of discrete data.
Benchmark of expert QA pairs for LLM reasoning in computer architecture; evaluation is on question answering, though domain is the focus.
Theoretical paper on aligning unpaired modalities via contrastive representations, a core multimodal learning problem.
Proposes UOT-RFM, a reweighted flow matching method for long-tailed generation.
SAE-Tuning uses sparse autoencoders to elicit reasoning abilities; SAEs are the core method.
Main contributions are annotation tool and dataset; Mamba-based state-space baseline is a secondary demonstration model.
Proposes a new dataset distillation method and benchmark for complex scenarios.
TAP planner is chiefly evaluated in the offline RL setting on Adroit and related tasks.
Core idea exploits a latent space of projection-based set representations to refine inputs for network verification.
RAR is a retrieval-and-ranking method that augments MLLMs for fine-grained recognition.
Benchmark evaluating temporal reasoning of large language models; LLMs are the subject of evaluation.
Diffusion transformer framework for end-to-end human-to-robot video generation.
TnT proposes multimodal table representations for LLMs, so multimodal handling of tables is central, though framed as a table-language model.
Proposes and evaluates GATS, using a GAN-based dynamics model within tree search; GANs are a core component.
Multi-agent debate for misinformation detection; LLMs are an unnamed underlying tool, not the subject of study.
Learns canonical head embeddings for dense correspondence; foundation models are not studied or used as a focus.
Builds a multimodal graph-LLM framework and instruction dataset for proteomics; the multimodal LLM is the proposed model.
Training-free guidance method for sampling from pretrained diffusion models for inpainting; diffusion is the core.
Proposes exact guidance framework for discrete flow matching; guidance is the core contribution.
Paper proposes a differentiable approximation of low-rank regularization; backpropagation compatibility is a benefit, not the subject.
Studies how personality shaping affects safety and capability of language models, evaluated on safety benchmarks.
Paper studies Lipschitz singularities in diffusion models; image generation is just the application domain and evaluation setting.
Proposes ANN-to-SNN conversion and compression framework for spiking neural networks.
Analyses and mitigates language bias in large vision-language models; the models are the subject.
Proposes PSAO, a prompt optimisation framework that can stand alone or combine with other optimisation methods.
Code2Video is a framework of three collaborative agents (Planner, Coder, Critic) for educational video generation.
Proposes a parameter-efficient multimodal co-adaptation framework tuning only 0.15% extra parameters; PEFT is the core of the method.
Studies data scheduling in fine-tuning and mid-training for target-domain data efficiency, which is post-training.
Proposes spectral flow matching as the core generative method for fMRI time series.
Paper proposes GP-based priors and variational inference for Bayesian neural networks; unit embeddings are only a component, not representation learning itself.
Paper trains LLM agents with internalized world models via self-play for agentic RL.
Proposes a physics-driven energy prediction model built on a Transformer with masked atomic modeling training.
Proposes learned acceleration policies specifically for Diffusion Transformers, evaluated on DiT backbones.
Animation framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting trees, binding Gaussians to deformed mesh; Gaussian splatting is the representation operated on.
Devises a sequence consistency transformer with new sequence-level tasks as core of the montage generation model.
Proposes a router-free MoE-LoRA method; mixture-of-experts design is the paper's core.
MatExpert framework leverages LLMs for retrieval, transition and generation in materials design; LLMs are the core engine.
Introduces neural Gaussian radio fields, a Gaussian-primitive representation adapted from splatting to wave-based channel estimation.
Studies length generalization of Transformers trained from scratch; LLMs appear only as motivation.
Mask-guided video subject swapping framework; diffusion transformer architecture is not discussed in the abstract.
Paper proposes a psychotherapy outcome evaluation framework; LLMs appear only as prior approaches, not the study subject.
Paper is about in-the-flow agentic system training; sparse reward is a challenge Flow-GRPO addresses, not the main focus.
AudioScope trains audio-visual separation without labels via MixIT and unsupervised coincidence model; close to self-supervised, though called unsupervised.
Paper proposes B-cos Vision Transformers that are inherently interpretable with holistic explanations; explainability is the main contribution.
Paper is about GP simplification and winning trees; symbolic regression is only the experimental validation domain.
Creates data and RLHF training to improve multi-step deductive reasoning in LLMs.
Learns 3D object detectors from other units' predictions; detection is the task studied and evaluated.
Core method is a layer-wise weight merging of a multimodal MLLM with a reasoning LLM.
Paper aligns vision-language models with gaze; LLMs not studied directly, GPT-4 only used for annotation.
Paper analyzes spatial ID mechanisms in vision-language models; video VLMs appear only as an extension of the analysis.
PhysVidBench benchmarks physical commonsense in text-to-video generation models; video generation is the evaluated subject.
Embodied agent framework ODM; transformers mentioned mainly as background for RL, architecture not the focus.
Bio-xLSTM evaluated for generative modeling, representations and in-context learning on biological sequences; ICL is a named result.
Neural organoid simulation framework and benchmark; spiking neural network only underlies one expansion platform.
Time series forecasting method; a frozen pretrained encoder is only one component, not about foundation models.
TAAR is a retrieval module scaling tabular foundation models such as TabPFN; these models are the subject.
LLM-driven framework generating heuristic operators within a genetic metaheuristic; LLM agent paradigm for VRPs.
Proposes jailbreak detection specifically for large vision-language models via neuron localization.
Extends DDIM to general diffusion models and analyses their sampling; diffusion models are the main topic.
Paper is about pool-based active learning (ASAL); adversarial sample generation is a component, and GANs are not discussed in the abstract.
Uncertainty-aware offline RL with neural SDEs; physics prior is only an optional inductive bias in the drift term.
Synthetic edit data to improve code synthesis; reasoning is not specifically studied or evaluated.
Hate speech classification via hand-built LDA/PDC feature sets and frequency models; not about learning representations.
Studies reasoning behaviors in agentic search and trains better search agents.
Train-free multi-LoRA composition method built on and evaluated in text-to-image diffusion models.
Paper studies transfer of disentangled representations and finds disentanglement predicts OOD performance.
Learns the transition structure of a POMDP with aliased deterministic observations and explores it efficiently.
Analyzes design space and optimization of autoregressive language models for image generation; LMs are the object of study.
FilMaster is an end-to-end automated film generation system, producing generated video with camera language and rhythm.
Proposes a new backdoor attack on CLIP via explicit concept manipulation, evaluated against defenses.
Proposes prompt tuning and Contextual Meta Transformer for sequence-modeling offline RL; transformer is the core architecture.
Theoretical generalization analysis of adversarially robust domain adaptation via Rademacher complexity.
Zero-shot subject-driven video customization with motion control; video generation is the task addressed.
Preference learning loss for regression, evaluated on alignment with analyst influences; alignment is treated loosely but is a result measure.
Paper builds causal knowledge extraction and counterfactual reasoning agents; retrieval-augmented generation is not the named focus.
WETAP is a new speculative decoding method with token-tree construction and pruning; the keyword is the core topic.
Embodied instruction following in unknown environments; MLLMs are one component of the hierarchical planner and controller framework.
Wolf combines image and video VLMs for video captioning, a vision-language task; multimodal fusion is the approach.
Proposes a hierarchical diffusion-based planner for long-horizon planning; the diffuser is the main method.
Proposes the first Diffusion Transformer-based framework for video face swapping.
Bayesian system identification for neural responses; visual stimuli are the data domain, not a vision method contribution.
ACT is an agentic decision-tree classifier; prompt optimization is only a contrasted baseline and TextGrad is a component.
Proposes an explicit-solution alternative to reduce reliance on backpropagation and compares optima against backpropagation.
Diffusion distillation framework mainly for fast sampling; video models are one of the applications alongside text-to-image.
Proposes a self-evolving multi-agent framework for LLM agents; agents are what the paper builds and evaluates.
Hierarchical goal-conditioned RL method; sparse rewards form the problem setting and motivation rather than the specific contribution.
Uncertainty-aware active procedure planning from instructional videos; visual reasoning only mentioned as part of existing approaches.
Paper introduces AnyECG, a pre-trained foundation model for ECG analysis; the model is the contribution.
Proposes a separated hierarchical Transformer and trains Transformers for circuit repair; the architecture is central to the method.
Proposes FDNet, a new deep time series forecasting network evaluated on forecasting benchmarks.
Paper is about LLM proxies for preference elicitation in course allocation; mechanism design is only a loosely related broader area.
Introduces data reliability scoring with the Gram determinant; strategic sources mentioned but mechanism design is not engaged.
Benchmark specifically measuring higher-level mathematical reasoning in LLMs; main experiments are on it.
Video try-on framework built on DiT backbones, injecting details into standard DiT blocks; DiT is the base architecture.
Paper is about dynamic frames for SE(3)-invariant crystal encoders; physics-informed ML is only a loose umbrella label.
Paper studies side-channel attacks and defenses on speculative decoding schemes; the technique is the core object of study.
Paper improves Decision Transformer adaptation in the offline RL setting; offline-trained DT is the base, though adaptation is the focus.
Paper is an AI-generated text detection corpus; AI safety is only a broad umbrella area.
Method modifies final blocks of diffusion transformers to convert flow models into flow maps; DiT is the architecture worked on.
Proposes a Neural ODE model for forecasting irregularly sampled time series, evaluated on forecasting benchmarks.
Optimizes LLM-based multi-agent systems across five dimensions; prompt optimization is not specifically named or engaged in the abstract.
MoRA is a KG-RAG framework evaluated chiefly on knowledge-graph question answering benchmarks.
AttMetNet's contribution is an attention-enhanced U-Net fused with NDMI; attention-driven feature selection is a main design element.
Character image animation framework generating videos with stable backgrounds; video generation is its core task.
Contribution is a desktop grounding dataset and GroundNext models for computer-use agents; MLLMs are not specifically engaged.
Builds a hallucination detector for faithful RAG outputs using sparse autoencoders; RAG is the target problem.
Targeted VAE for causal parameter estimation; disentanglement is not engaged in the abstract.
Proposes state decomposition theory and metric for the gap between states and observations in POMDPs.
Routing strategy for MoE-based multimodal large language models; these models are the object of the method.
Proposes a topic-based domain adaptation method for BERT using semi-structured document information.
Antimicrobial peptide benchmark comparing sequence and structure inputs; multimodal learning is not itself the focus.
FinLoRA benchmarks LoRA methods, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning approach, on financial tasks.
Paper proposes flow-matching planner with data balancing; diffusion is only a related generative family, not what is studied.
Diffusion-based predictor to make offline RL robust to state perturbations; evaluated on offline RL algorithms.
Data selection for visual instruction finetuning, framed as a post-training step; keyword is the broad stage the method targets.
Paper employs LLMs as decision-makers for autonomous driving; LLM reasoning is the core method.
Paper proposes a 3D Gaussian Splatting self-supervised framework pre-training 2D and 3D encoders for 3D tasks such as detection and reconstruction.
Shows memory-augmented Transformers implement optimization algorithms on regression tasks, the in-context learning setting, though the abstract never names it.
G-code generation for CNC manufacturing from shape data; 3D vision is only a loose umbrella area.
Studies trajectory deviation attacks on agentic LLM systems, targeting agent reasoning loops.
SELF-PARAM proposes a method for updating LLMs by integrating knowledge into parameters; LLMs are the object.
Studies whether domain generalization methods and stable features improve privacy; domain generalization is a core subject.
Framework tokenizes and aligns 3D Gaussian Splatting structures with text and images.
SeqSHAP is a Shapley-based explainer for sequential predictions, a direct XAI contribution.
Gaze-informed disambiguation evaluated on MLLMs; the title and experiments center on multimodal LLMs.
Paper proposes a new hyperparameter-free model merging method (GMF-Mean); merging is the main subject.
Whisfusion builds ASR decoding on a masked-diffusion transformer decoder with parallel diffusion decoding.
TSci is an LLM-driven framework built from four specialized cooperating agents; the multi-agent design is the contribution.
Builds and evaluates an antibody language model integrating structure and sequence; the paper is about such LLMs.
Builds a fully SSM-only (Mamba) conditioning path for TTS; state space modeling is the core.
FineR uses LLM world knowledge to reason about fine-grained category names; LLMs are core to the method and title.
Introduces Sparse Component Alignment to measure representational alignment between brains and neural networks.
Case study compressing and interpreting MLP computation in modular addition models; squarely mechanistic interpretability.
Paper builds a Transformer DNA encoder for sequence alignment; LLMs serve only as inspiration and motivation.
Distilling reasoning from free-text rationales evaluated on question answering; text classification is not addressed.
RepARe rephrases questions to improve zero-shot VQA in LVLMs; visual reasoning is a loose umbrella for the task.
Proposes a communication correction for experience replay in multi-agent reinforcement learning.
Paper introduces a dataset to evaluate and improve MLLMs on music sheet understanding and fine-tunes an MLLM.
Proposes variance- and energy-controlling guidance for diffusion inference-time scaling, compared against pure guidance baselines.
Benchmark evaluates multimodal LLMs (foundation models) on point-light motion; the models themselves are the object of study.
BugScope is an inference-time alignment framework for LLM auditing; agents are not the explicit subject.
Proposes an internal-gap-based self-improvement framework for MLLMs and studies co-improvement.
Proposes safety margin alignment specifically for vision-language models and analyzes their failures.
Applies dictionary learning to interpret microscopy foundation models' internal features and proposes a new algorithm for monosemantic features.
Low-light enhancement framework whose key module is Reliable Cross Attention, named in the title; attention is a core contribution.
Generative occupancy world model producing 3D/4D scenes; generation of 3D content is the main task, though framed as prediction.
MVDream is a text-to-image diffusion model generating consistent multi-view images, used as a 3D prior.
Studies and induces latent point collapse in latent representations; latent space is the subject.
Proposes Bayesian Stackelberg Q-learning for a multi-agent Markov game between defender and adversary.
Theoretically models LLM self-improvement training dynamics via the solver-verifier gap.
Paper attacks RAG systems via poisoned documents; LLMs are the victim setting, not what is studied or improved.
Paper extends conformal prediction to general right-censored survival data, constructing valid predictive bounds.
Trains and evaluates LLM-based code preference models and compares to human preference; LLMs are the subject.
Mines knowledge from large foundation model SAM to improve small segmentation models; large-model interaction is the key idea.
OmniVideoBench evaluates audio-visual video understanding in MLLMs; video is the benchmark's core.
Paper explains in-context learning as Bayesian and derives scaling laws for it; ICL is the object of study.
